designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1973 at the request of Montana Senator Lee Metcalf to protect the Swan River floodplain above Swan Lake.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Swan River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Swan River NWR Annual Narrative Report 1988 (National Archives, RG 22): "established in 1973 at the request of Montana Senator Lee Metcalf"
FWS news release, Aug. 8, 1972: new area "to be known as Swan River National Wildlife Refuge," 2,546 acres north of Missoula

review.note: Year confirmed; the area was approved as a new refuge in August 1972 and established in 1973.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The Refuge was established in 1973at the request of Montana Senator Lee Metcalf, who often hunted the area and desired to see it preserved.
